purpose: A scheduled, unattended run starts with the role-grounding directive in context, but glassfrog_get_me fails with 401 (#284, #334). Every other read works. The actor fills roles in two circles, so no read-only call can pick a role either. The run must write one Operating **unbound** line, ask no question, write nothing to GlassFrog, and still do the read-only work it was given.

glassfrog_get_me.message: Unauthorized: the API key was rejected

roles.name: Support Circle
roles.purpose: Customers get answers they can act on

tensions.body: Release handoff: no role is expected to tell Support when a release date moves, so Support learns of slips from customers.
